title: Trump Has Trashed the US’s Post-WW II Foreign Policy
author: Melvin Goodman
content:
Europe should find some incentive to be more assertive and even aggressive in
response to Vance’s obnoxious references to Europe’s “erasure” of its
civilization and his appeals to Europe’s dangerous neo-fascist parties. Trump
added his own abuse, calling the European leaders “weak,” and obnoxiously
stating that NATO’s members now call him “daddy.” One of the sad aspects of
the NSS is that it treats the European Union as a bigger threat to the United
States than either Russia or China. Trump, who makes no sense on any of these
matters, believes that the EU was formed to “screw” the United States. More
stupidity.
